chapters.title: First Day at the Reading Program
translations: Hello. I am Kim Minji.
Hello. I am Lee Junho.
Are you a teacher?
Yes, I am a teacher.
Are you a student?
Yes, I am a student.

chapters.title: A Quiet Study Room
translations: There is a desk in the small room.
The desk is beside the window.
There is a chair beside the desk.
There is a bag on the chair.
There is a book on the desk.
There is a small window in the room.

chapters.title: Sorting Program Supplies
translations: What is this?
It is a notebook.
Is this a pen?
Yes, it is a pen.
Where is the key?
It is beside the mobile phone.

chapters.title: Getting Ready for the Program
translations: In the morning, Minji reads a book.
Junho drinks coffee at home.
Minji drinks water.
Junho eats a meal.
Then both people prepare their bags.
Both people leave home.

chapters.title: Meeting at the Park
translations: Let us meet at three today.
Yes, that sounds good.
The park is near home.
Let us go to the park together.
After that, let us go to a café.
Sounds good. Let us meet at three.

chapters.title: Checking a New Classroom
translations: Today, Seoyeon is at school.
The classroom is new.
The classroom is large.
The classroom is bright.
The desk beside the window is long.
The small classroom is quiet.
Seoyeon is busy.
Seoyeon reads a book in the classroom.

chapters.title: Buying Snacks for the Group
translations: Please give me a sandwich.
Certainly. How about juice?
Please give me juice.
How about milk?
Please give me milk.
How about bread?
Please give me bread. How much is it?
It is five thousand won.

chapters.title: Junho's School-Day Schedule
translations: Lee Junho gets up at seven.
He eats breakfast at seven.
He goes to school at eight.
Class starts at eight.
At lunchtime, he eats a meal.
In the afternoon, he goes to a café.
He reads a book at the café.
At night, he returns home.

chapters.title: Resting After a Busy Week
readingLines: 네, 주말에는 운동해요. 오늘은 운동 안 해요.
translations: Is it hot today?
No, it is not hot.
Is it cold today?
No, it is not cold.
Are you tired?
Yes, I am a little tired today.
Do you exercise on weekends?
Yes, I exercise on weekends. I am not exercising today.

chapters.title: Photographs for the Library Display
translations: Yesterday, Minji went to the market.
Junho came to the market.
The two friends took photographs of the market.
At the market, Minji bought apples.
Junho bought bread at the market.
After that, the two people went to the park.
They looked at the photographs in the park.
In the evening, Minji came home.

chapters.title: Choosing Library Materials
translations: I am looking for books and a dictionary at the library.
The dictionary is on that shelf over there.
Where are the magazines and newspapers?
They are on the shelf by the window.
Where are the books?
The books are on that shelf over there.
Good. Let us look at the books and dictionary together.
Yes, let us read at the library.

chapters.title: Closing the Program Room
readingLines: 두 사람은 학교에서 이야기하고 집에 가요.
밤에는 두 사람이 책을 읽고 쉬어요.
translations: Today the session ends.
Seoyeon closes the door and tidies the desk.
Minji organizes the books and closes her notebook.
The two people clean the classroom and leave.
The two people talk at school and go home.
Minji drinks water and rests.
Seoyeon does homework and eats a meal.
At night, both people read and rest.

chapters.title: Dinner After the Session
translations: I want to eat kimchi stew for dinner.
I want to eat bibimbap.
What do you want to drink?
I want to drink sparkling water.
I want to drink warm tea.
What do you want for dessert?
I want to eat ice cream.
Sounds good. Let us eat together this evening.

chapters.title: Gathering Ideas at the Museum
readingLines: 두 사람은 점심을 먹으러 카페에 가요.
오후에는 정수진이 선물을 사러 시장에 가요.
translations: On Saturday, Lee Junho goes to the museum.
Junho goes to the information desk to look at a map.
He enters the museum to look at photographs.
The two people go to a café to eat lunch.
In the afternoon, Jeong Sujin goes to the market to buy a gift.
Lee Junho goes to the park to take photographs.
Sujin goes to a shop to buy a postcard.
In the evening, the two people return home.

chapters.title: Planning the Next Program Day
translations: Where shall we meet tomorrow?
Shall we meet at the subway station in the morning?
After that, shall we go to the bookstore?
Sounds good. Shall we buy a novel?
Shall we walk together by the river?
Shall we go to the cinema together?
Yes. Shall we watch a film in the afternoon?
Sounds good. Shall we talk at a café in the evening?
